setting-showsortbutton-comment: shows a sort button at the top of the screen while a chest is open
setting-showsortsummary-comment: (client side) says in chat how many stacks got merged and moved after every sort
setting-startcategoriesonnewrow: start categories on a new row
setting-startcategoriesonnewrow-comment: leaves a gap so every category starts on its own row
setting-keepgroupsinonechest-comment: moves a group of the same items to the next chest instead of splitting it between two, when there is room
setting-mergeintoonechest-comment: merged chests act like one big chest with all of their slots in one grid, instead of every chest getting its own part of the window
